properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.access-channel
properties.description: The access channel of the RocketMQ client: LOCAL for an Apache RocketMQ cluster, or CLOUD for a RocketMQ service of a cloud provider. With CLOUD the message traces go to a trace topic per region, in the format of the cloud service.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.access-key
properties.description: The access key of the RocketMQ ACL credentials. The producer and the consumer sign their requests only when both accessKey and secretKey are set. The consumer of replyToTopic does not use it.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.bridge-error-handler
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.consumer-group
properties.description: The consumer group of the consumer. The consumers of a group share the messages of the topic, and each message goes to one of them. The consumer fails to start if it is not set.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.enable-trace
properties.description: Whether the producer and the consumer record message traces, which the RocketMQ client sends to the trace topic RMQ_SYS_TRACE_TOPIC. The consumer of replyToTopic does not record traces.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the rocketmq component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.message-selector-type
properties.description: How the consumer selects the messages of the topic that it receives: tag uses the subscribeTags option, and sql uses the subscribeSql option.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.namespace
properties.description: The namespace of the topics and groups, which the RocketMQ client sends with each request. Set it for a RocketMQ instance that uses namespaces, such as a serverless instance. The consumer of replyToTopic does not use it.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.namesrv-addr
properties.description: The address of the RocketMQ name server, as host:port. Separate several name servers with a semicolon.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.producer-group
properties.description: The producer group of the producer. The producer fails to start if it is not set.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.reply-to-consumer-group
properties.description: The consumer group that receives the replies on replyToTopic, required with replyToTopic. Use a group per producer: in a shared group a reply can reach another producer, which ignores it, and the exchange times out.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.reply-to-topic
properties.description: The topic on which the producer receives the reply of an InOut exchange. The reply must carry the keys of the request, one of which the producer generates to match the reply. If not set, an InOut exchange does not wait for a reply.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.request-timeout-checker-interval-millis
properties.description: How often, in milliseconds, the producer checks for InOut exchanges whose requestTimeoutMillis has passed. A timeout can be detected up to this interval late.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.request-timeout-millis
properties.description: How long, in milliseconds, the producer waits for the reply of an InOut exchange on replyToTopic before it fails the exchange with an ExchangeTimedOutException. A value of 0 or less waits for Integer.MAX_VALUE milliseconds (about 24 days).

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.secret-key
properties.description: The secret key of the RocketMQ ACL credentials. The producer and the consumer sign their requests only when both accessKey and secretKey are set. The consumer of replyToTopic does not use it.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.send-tag
properties.description: The tag of each message that the producer sends. The CamelRocketMQOverrideTag header replaces it. If not set, the messages are sent with an empty tag.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.subscribe-sql
properties.description: The SQL92 expression on the message properties that selects the messages that the consumer receives, when messageSelectorType is sql. The broker must have enablePropertyFilter set to true. The default 1 = 1 receives all messages.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.subscribe-tags
properties.description: The tags of the messages that the consumer receives, when messageSelectorType is tag. Separate several tags with ||, for example TagA||TagB. The default * receives all messages.

properties.name: camel.component.rocketmq.wait-for-send-result
properties.description: Whether the producer waits for the send result before the exchange continues. When true, a send that fails, or whose status is not SEND_OK, fails the exchange. When false, an InOnly exchange continues as soon as the message is handed to the RocketMQ client, and a failed send is only logged. An InOut exchange always waits for the send result, and for the reply when replyToTopic is set.
